niche_preference_profile: Prefers light, neutral interfaces with soft purple accents, clear content hierarchy, concise and uncluttered presentation, spacious spacing, and refined but low-depth components. Favors text-labeled, clearly organized UI with visible structure, active-looking CTAs, and simple open layouts over dark, high-contrast, icon-heavy, boxed, or visually dense designs.

top_7_criteria.description: Prefers light neutral backgrounds, soft gray surfaces, and cool purple accents rather than dark backgrounds, harsh contrast, or warmer/red accent tones.
Prefers organized layouts with clear sections, strong labeling, readable hierarchy, and structured presentation of content and controls.
Prefers cleaner screens with fewer decorative or competing elements, avoiding unnecessary icons, extra containers, and distracting visual layers.
Prefers airy layouts with consistent padding, breathing room, and less compressed stacking of elements.
Prefers flatter, more open presentation with little elevation or framing, such as inline indicators instead of boxed or shadowed cards.
Prefers actions and controls that are explicitly labeled and easy to interpret, with visible cues such as text labels, ordering markers, and clear affordances.
Prefers polished modern UI components with subtle borders, rounded corners, stronger contrast where needed, and active-looking primary buttons rather than muted or underdefined controls.
